experience.description: Lead engineer for the company's platform and its AI work. Co-architected The Notwork, the platform behind North Carolina's first state-backed esports and STEM league, and have run it on my own since October 2025.
bullets: Co-architected The Notwork in Next.js, React 19 and TypeScript. More than 10,000 people have used it, with over 900 on it in a single day at its peak.
Hired and led five developers for the first build: set the coding standards, reviewed pull requests every week and worked through tickets with product and design.

Sole engineer and product owner since October 2025, after leading the team through the 2025 rebuild: a redesigned schema, notifications end to end, server-side pagination, error handling and logging, and hundreds of regression tests.

Built a nine-step AI curriculum pipeline on the Vercel AI SDK: AI drafts each step, and a person approves it before the next one runs. A lesson that took about a week now takes half an hour or less, and more than 50 have been published.
Built AI-assisted rubric grading, where staff review every score before it counts, and made teachers the verifiers for in-person competition.
Set up AI tools for the whole company, including a Claude team workspace and MCP integrations into the platform, and trained the staff to use them.
Designed and built more than 10 browser games on my own in Pixi.js and Three.js, most of them for a skilled-trades program, without having made a game before.

experience.role: Co-founder & Director of Curriculum and Programming
experience.description: Co-founded the company and ran CTAC, its coding program for adults changing careers: the curriculum, the daily teaching, the cohorts and the sponsoring employers.
bullets: Wrote the curriculum and taught it every day as the only instructor for two years, then supervised a third: about 130 adults, more than half of the program's graduates.
More than 100 of them were hired into full-time roles at Charlotte employers, including Bank of America, Wells Fargo, Lowe's, Ally, Coca-Cola Consolidated and Truist.
Led a four-person curriculum team on a cohort build for an outside client.
Worked with the sponsoring employers so each cohort learned what their hiring teams needed.
Set up hiring, onboarding and program operations from the company's founding.
